newsitem.title: USA: MasterCard unveils new line of credit cards.
newsitem.headline: MasterCard unveils new line of credit cards.

text.p: MasterCard International Inc said Tuesday it launched a new family of premium credit products, centered around the World MasterCard card.

The World MasterCard card does not have a pre-set spending limit, but offers an option to revolve a designated portion of the charges, as well as global acceptance, global customer service and a rewards program, the company said.

The card would be complemented by a platinum class MasterCard featuring a high revolving credit line and other benefits, the company said. The new line of cards would focus on the travel and entertainment industries, MasterCard said.
MasterCard is currently suing Advanta Corp and American Express Co, alleging trademark infringement, unfair competition, breach of contract and interference with contractual relations.
MasterCard said its lawsuit would require Advanta and American Express to discontinue their Rewards Accelerator programs, saying it used a MasterCard trademark to promote American Express products.
MasterCard has nearly 370 million credit and debit cards accepted at about 13 million locations worldwide. In 1995, gross dollar volume generated was almost $500 billion.
